title: BACE: Safety & Workplace Culture - Biotechnology - Identification of Hazards
subject: Biotechnology

questions.q: Which color on the NFPA 704 diamond indicates 'Instability' or 'Reactivity'?
questions.explain: Yellow indicates Instability/Reactivity hazards (susceptibility to release energy). Blue is Health, Red is Flammability, White is Special.
